text:
Ana: Heads-up — Greystone asked for our SOC 2 Type II PDF + a short bridge memo to approve a week-long POC. they want a presigned S3 link. can we share before an NDA? cc @Tess (Legal) @Ravi (Security)
Marcus: Greystone is a mid-market buyer, wants fast unblock. sales preference: redacted snapshot + bridge note to keep momentum.
Tess (Legal): we require an executed NDA before issuing presigned links to SOC artifacts. we can, however, share a tightly redacted "snapshot summary" (cover page + controls matrix + sample evidence) directly in email if the customer agrees to our limited use language. i will prepare an NDA + bridge memo. need client legal contact.
Ravi (Security): requirements: remove any PII, internal usernames, unique request IDs, and third-party IP addresses. redaction checklist will be short. bridge language must be non-attestational beyond scope and period. ops must sign the bridge.
InfraBot: Policy reminder: presigned links for SOC artifacts must expire <= 7 days and assets must be tagged `sensitive:soc2`. See runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/soc2-sharing
Ana: client contact is j.lopez@greystone.io. they asked if bridge can say "no findings" for the period 125-11-30.
Tess (Legal): we cannot say "no findings" for a full Type II without sharing the full report via an authorized reviewer workflow. bridge can say: "No exceptions identified in the provided scoped artifacts for period 2025-11-01 to 2025-11-30."
Marcus: timeline: if NDA signed today, can we have the snapshot + presign within 36h?
Ravi (Security): engineering can assemble a redacted snapshot in ~24h after scope sign-off. presign command we use: `aws s3 presign s3://redwood-soc2/greystone-snapshot-2026.pdf --expires-in 604800` (we'll set expiry to 7d or less). we only generate after NDA executed.
Tess (Legal): i'll draft NDA + bridge now and send to j.lopez@greystone.io; also include required access controls and redaction terms. if they ask for CAIQ/SIG responses, we can share our completed CAIQ spreadsheet but that also needs NDA.
Ana: noted. action items: Tess send NDA + bridge; Ravi prepare redaction checklist & scope; Marcus keep client warm. i'll update thread once signed. :eyes:
Marcus: on it. pinged client.
Ravi (Security): starting redaction pass. will confirm logs retention status.
Tess (Legal): NDA sent to j.lopez@greystone.io and cc'd Ana. will update when signed.
Ana: thanks everyone.
